classification: Bounded shared Activity Log process-identity repair; no native updater, skill or broader acceptance

repair.owner: Existing Activity Log store policy and orphan inspection
repair.soleWriter: A matching instance id alone does not make a different live PID the local writer. A same-PID predecessor and a confirmed-dead peer retain existing semantics.
repair.orphan: The same-process reason requires both PID and instance id. Ordinary exited, stale and current-name rules remain unchanged.
repair.logging: Existing activity-log.policy.conflict and activity-log.segment.recovered operations retain their registered policyResolution and ownerState evidence; no new emitter, operation, id grammar or sensitive payload.

causalControls.scope: Actual canonical segment producer/parser and actual store-policy file I/O with explicitly injected peer liveness

limits: No real updater process takeover, installed version transition, PID-namespace identity integration or customer-platform acceptance is inferred.
No skill result, protocol outcome, acceptance disposition or issue checkbox changes.
Final publication checks and any independent after-controls are separately retained.
